title: Keep the integration queue's waiting toast up until the hold clears
body:
When the integration queue is held (it cannot run and every card waits behind it), show a corner notification that says what it is waiting for, keep it up while the hold lasts, and remove it when the hold clears. Nothing more. No buttons, no agents.

A hold toast already exists, and it fails in two ways (src/wm.rs report_integration, TurnEvent::Held):
1. It shows for toast_secs, 6 s by default. A dirty main checkout can hold the queue for an hour, so if you weren't looking during those 6 s you never learn the queue is stuck.
2. The dedup field `IntegrationDriver.last_hold` is set and never cleared. Once a hold clears, the same hold coming back later (same dirty files, same text) never toasts again for the life of that window.

Do:
- Add a keyed sticky toast to src/notify.rs: show or replace by key, clear by key, and click to dismiss. Keep the existing transient API unchanged.
- Key the hold toast by repository, so two project windows on one clone show one toast. Show it on Held. Replace it when the hold text changes. Clear it when a turn runs without a hold or the queue empties. Clearing also resets the dedup, so a later hold toasts again.
- The text leads with what it waits for and what clears it, e.g. "Integration queue waiting: main has uncommitted changes (src/wm.rs, src/main.rs). Commit or stash to resume." Build it from the hold detail, with no new git calls.
- Leave hand-back and other toasts as they are.
- If w4ufci (the progress UI) has landed, keep its held banner. This toast is the alert, the banner is the status.

Pointers: docs/integration-queue.md (Held), src/wm.rs (IntegrationDriver, integration_tick, report_integration), src/notify.rs, src/integrate.rs (TurnEvent, HOLD_BACKOFF).

Done when:
- Unit tests cover: a hold shows one sticky toast; a repeated identical hold adds no duplicate; clearing the hold removes it; the same hold coming back shows it again (the regression); and click-dismiss works.
- `cargo test --target-dir target/agent` passes.
- A screenshot shows the toast while main is dirty (ask the user to run build-screenshot).
- The Held bullet in docs/integration-queue.md is updated.
